name: confirm_live_identity
description: Unlock approved returning-user memory only after Amy has completed a useful warm exchange, asked exactly 'What name would you like me to use?', received a real spoken name rather than User, Visitor, Guest, or Customer, and separately received explicit permission to check for notes from an earlier conversation. Never ask for or submit an email address for memory access; the application privately verifies the session-bound website check-in identity. After success, follow the returned instruction and prefer the newest approved notes over older superseded context.

preferredName.description: The real name the visitor stated after Amy asked 'What name would you like me to use?'. Never submit User, Visitor, Guest, or Customer.

memoryAccessConfirmed.description: True only after the visitor explicitly agrees that Amy may check for approved notes from a previous conversation.
